description: ONDEWO Voip Telephone System Integration (VTSI) Client library for Typescript

scripts.build:test:auth: tsc auth/offlineTokenProvider.ts auth/offlineTokenProvider.spec.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --sourceMap --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --outDir .test-build
scripts.build:test:examples: tsc examples/listVtsiProjects.ts examples/listVtsiProjects.spec.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --sourceMap --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --outDir .test-build
scripts.build:test:protos: tsc tests/asteriskVersion.spec.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --sourceMap --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --outDir .test-build
scripts.pretest: npm run build:test:auth && npm run build:test:examples && npm run build:test:protos && npm run typecheck:examples
scripts.test: c8 --check-coverage --lines 100 --branches 100 --functions 100 --include '**/offlineTokenProvider.js' --exclude '**/*.spec.js' --reporter text node --test .test-build/offlineTokenProvider.spec.js && node --test .test-build/listVtsiProjects.spec.js && npm run test:protos
